classical_upper_bound_arm.name: cls_es
classical_upper_bound_arm.definition: the classical schedule's 28 knobs (7 classes x go_ref, go_beats, brake_beats, brake_ref) optimised with exactly the v11 ES budget (pop 16, 16 generations, 8 cases/task/generation with full coverage, crash-aware ranking, lr decay 0.85), selection on 64 cases/task (0 crashes), blind 2_099_100_000 x 64/task vs the untouched opponent; module descend_cls.py; sigma 0.05 / lr 0.02 in knob-normalised units (refs/0.5 rad, beats/20)
classical_upper_bound_arm.purpose: if the classical controller with the same optimisation budget cannot reach 0.95 either, the criterion and not the learned layer is what fails; it also gives the honest ceiling for the paired delta
